columns.name: campaign_budget_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign budget. A campaign budget is created using the CampaignBudgetService create operation and is assigned a budget ID. A budget ID can be shared across different campaigns; the system will then allocate the campaign budget among different campaigns to get optimum results.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: campaign_budget_recommended_budget_estimated_change_weekly_clicks
columns.comment: The estimated change in weekly clicks if the recommended budget is applied. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_budget_recommended_budget_estimated_change_weekly_cost_micros
columns.comment: The estimated change in weekly cost in micros if the recommended budget is applied. One million is equivalent to one currency unit. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_budget_recommended_budget_estimated_change_weekly_interactions
columns.comment: The estimated change in weekly interactions if the recommended budget is applied. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_budget_recommended_budget_estimated_change_weekly_views
columns.comment: The estimated change in weekly views if the recommended budget is applied. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.comment: The name of the campaign. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new campaigns. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.

columns.name: campaign_status
columns.comment: The status of the campaign. When a new campaign is added, the status defaults to ENABLED.

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions_from_interactions_rate
columns.comment: All conversions from interactions (as oppose to view through conversions) divided by the number of ad interactions.

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions_value
columns.comment: The total value of all conversions.

columns.name: metrics_average_cost
columns.comment: The average amount you pay per interaction. This amount is the total cost of your ads divided by the total number of interactions.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpc
columns.comment: The total cost of all clicks divided by the total number of clicks received.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpe
columns.comment: The average amount that you've been charged for an ad engagement. This amount is the total cost of all ad engagements divided by the total number of ad engagements.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpm
columns.comment: Average cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM).

columns.name: metrics_average_cpv
columns.comment: The average amount you pay each time someone views your ad. The average CPV is defined by the total cost of all ad views divided by the number of views.

columns.name: metrics_clicks
columns.comment: The number of clicks.

columns.name: metrics_conversions
columns.comment: The number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_conversions_from_interactions_rate
columns.comment: Conversions from interactions divided by the number of ad interactions (such as clicks for text ads or views for video ads). This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_conversions_value
columns.comment: The total value of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_cost_micros
columns.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period.

columns.name: metrics_cost_per_all_conversions
columns.comment: The cost of ad interactions divided by all conversions.

columns.name: metrics_cost_per_conversion
columns.comment: The cost of ad interactions divided by conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_cross_device_conversions
columns.comment: Conversions from when a customer clicks on a Google Ads ad on one device, then converts on a different device or browser. Cross-device conversions are already included in all_conversions.

columns.name: metrics_ctr
columns.comment: The number of clicks your ad receives (Clicks) divided by the number of times your ad is shown (Impressions).

columns.name: metrics_engagement_rate
columns.comment: How often people engage with your ad after it's shown to them. This is the number of ad expansions divided by the number of times your ad is shown.

columns.name: metrics_engagements
columns.comment: The number of engagements. An engagement occurs when a viewer expands your Lightbox ad. Also, in the future, other ad types may support engagement metrics.

columns.name: metrics_impressions
columns.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

columns.name: metrics_interaction_event_types
columns.comment: The types of payable and free interactions.

columns.name: metrics_interaction_rate
columns.comment: How often people interact with your ad after it is shown to them. This is the number of interactions divided by the number of times your ad is shown.

columns.name: metrics_interactions
columns.comment: The number of interactions. An interaction is the main user action associated with an ad format-clicks for text and shopping ads, views for video ads, and so on.

columns.name: metrics_trueview_average_cpv
columns.comment: The average amount you pay each time someone views your ad. The average CPV is defined by the total cost of all ad views divided by the number of TrueView views.

columns.name: metrics_value_per_all_conversions
columns.comment: The value of all conversions divided by the number of all conversions.

columns.name: metrics_value_per_conversion
columns.comment: The value of conversions divided by the number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_video_trueview_view_rate
columns.comment: The number of TrueView views your video ad receives divided by its number of impressions, including thumbnail impressions for TrueView in-display ads.

columns.name: metrics_video_trueview_views
columns.comment: The number of TrueView views your video ads received.

columns.name: metrics_video_view_rate
columns.comment: The number of views your TrueView video ad receives divided by its number of impressions, including thumbnail impressions for TrueView in-display ads.

columns.name: metrics_video_views
columns.comment: The number of times your video ads were viewed.

columns.name: metrics_view_through_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of view-through conversions. These happen when a customer sees an image or rich media ad, then later completes a conversion on your site without interacting with (e.g., clicking on) another ad.

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.
